stance_basis: paraphrased providing factual information about bridge access points without expressing support or opposition
summary: Frank Mattone, a member of the city planning staff, is mentioned once in the document window in a paraphrased statement providing factual details about the expressway's planned bridge crossings into the Randolph area. He describes the number and locations of the five vehicle and pedestrian bridges to be built over the expressway. No opinion for or against the project is attributed to him.
complaint_summary: Frank Mattone is paraphrased as stating that the expressway will be crossed by five vehicle and pedestrian bridges for easy access into the Randolph area, to be located at Meadow, Randolph, and Harrison streets and Allen and Davis avenues.
summary_quote: The expressway will be crossed by five vehicle and pedestrian bridges for easy access into the Rundolph area. Frank Mattone, a member of the city planning staff, said.
